extraction.title: Take the iPhone, garnish with globalisation
extraction.subtitle: Tim Cook wrote a winning recipe for Apple Will it work for his successor?
extraction.summary: As Tim Cook's tenure at Apple comes to an end, his successor John Ternus faces the challenge of adapting Apple's successful formula of smartphones and global supply chains to the evolving landscape of AI and geopolitical tensions. Cook's leadership saw Apple's market value grow significantly, but the future may require a shift in strategy.
